raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Nielsen - Software Engineer 1 July 2024 – Present – Technologies: SCALA, Spark, EMR, Athena, S3, Postgres, MySQL, Airflow, Python, GitLab, Jira,
REST APIs
Architected and deployed end-to-end Airflow + Scala data pipelines processing 500M+ records weekly, enabling near-real-time client reporting and reducing data latency by 35%.
Designed and implemented data aggregation workflows to convert daily campaign viewership data into weekly, monthly, and annual reports, improving reporting speed and accuracy.
Proactively identified and eliminated data slippage across dependent Spark pipelines, enhancing pipeline reliability and ensuring SLA compliance.
Optimized Spark jobs for performance and cost efficiency, achieving a 20% reduction in cluster resource usage through partitioning, broadcast joins, and tuning.
Resolved production bottlenecks and implemented monitoring using Airflow alerts + CloudWatch, minimizing downtime and improving system resilience.
Cognizant - Associate Software Engineer – Technologies: Python, Pyspark, Hadoop, Spark SQL, MySQL, Hive, Sqoop, HDFS, GCP – Developed and maintained distributed Spark applications handling terabyte-scale datasets for
Feb 2021 – July 2024
enterprise-grade reporting and analytics.
Performed detailed data analysis using Hive and Spark SQL to resolve data consistency issues during SIT/UAT phases, improving data quality in production.
Implemented Spark performance tuning strategies including caching, partitioning, and serialization optimizations, resulting in a 40% reduction in job runtime.
Created and managed RDD and DataFrame transformations for large-scale ETL pipelines on YARN- managed clusters.
Integrated Sqoop and Hive for seamless ingestion from RDBMS to HDFS, automating data ingestion workflows and reducing manual intervention.
Led root-cause analysis and resolution of critical data pipeline issues, ensuring minimal business dis- ruption.
